scope: Weber County residential-use land, including rural tracts; exploratory retrospective research
evidenceStatus: Explicit sold prices in county-hosted MLS exhibits; not settlement-statement verification. Listing-era attributes reconstructed from later printed reports; not immutable pre-sale snapshots. Public-as-of replay not established. Arm-length status is not independently established.

protocol.primary: First five chronological sales train; final two held out together
protocol.secondary: Expanding chronological training, minimum three preceding sales
protocol.model: Fixed alpha=10 ridge log-price regression; nonlinear log-acreage hinge, geography, utility categories, date. No test-based tuning.
